author: same assistant
text: Workshop analysis: R already funds Libyan cooperation, a public update and protected two-way outreach for victims, witnesses, affected communities and representatives outside Libya; inside coverage is missing. Extend the existing channel to those groups inside Libya and request a line-by-line update on all four inquiries. Outreach/reporting needs staff and witness-privacy safeguards; narrower outreach costs less but risks selectivity. These recommendations do not establish Brazilian endorsement of R or a future vote.
